Scourge of the seven seas.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Skel-Bone
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船 1层魔物]^000000
6. 邪骸海盗
一个没有上衣、穿着紫色袜子蹦蹦跳跳的邪骸海盗。七大洋的噩梦。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：邪骸骨

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
1. Kukre
Kukre look better than Thief Bugs
but basically loot items just the
same. Luckily, they don't attack
players in a group.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Worm Peeling, Garlet,
Monster's Feed, Red Herb, Insect
Feeler
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船 2层魔物]^000000
1. 库克雷
库克雷比浮勒盗虫看起来更漂亮，但基本上也是同样地掠夺物品。幸运的是，它们不会攻击成群的玩家。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：虫皮、加勒结晶、魔物饲料、红色药草、昆虫触角

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
2. Hydra
Vegetable Monsters that live near
water or in the deep sea that
attack using tentacles. As a group,
they're a pain in the ass.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Tentacle, Sticky Mucus,
Meat
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船 2层魔物]^000000
2. 海葵
生活在水边或深海中的植物魔物，使用触手进行攻击。成群出现时非常棘手。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：触手、粘稠液体、肉

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
3. Poporing
A light green Poring with the
Poison property. It's much stronger
than Poring, but still moves by
means of bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Sticky Mucus,
Garlet, Green Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船 2层魔物]^000000
3. 波波利
一种带有毒属性的浅绿色波利。它比波利强大得多，但仍然是通过弹跳移动。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：粘稠液体、加勒结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
4. Thara Frog
Red Frogs that are much stronger
than the green Roda Frogs. They
also produce an annoying croaking
noise.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Spawn, Scell, Sticky
Webfoot
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船 2层魔物]^000000
4. 达拉蛙
比绿色罗达蛙强大得多的红色青蛙。它们还会发出令人烦恼的呱呱声。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛙卵、雪勒结晶、粘稠脚蹼

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
5. Whisper
A piece of living fabric that gives
off spooky vibes. Sometimes, it
likes to turn invisible...
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Fabric
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船 2层魔物]^000000
5. 白幽灵
一块散发诡异气息的活体布料。有时候，它喜欢变得隐形...
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：布料

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
6. Megalodon
Skeleton Fish having spooky empty
eye-holes.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Stinky Scale, Skel-Bone
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船 2层魔物]^000000
6. 邪骸食人鱼
拥有诡异空洞眼窝的邪骸鱼。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：腐烂鳞片、邪骸骨

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
7. Pirate Skel
A topless pirate skeleton that
skips around in purple socks.
Scourge of the seven seas.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Skel-Bone
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船 2层魔物]^000000
7. 邪骸海盗
一个上身赤裸、穿着紫色袜子的邪骸海盗，蹦蹦跳跳地四处游荡。
它是七大洋的噩梦。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：邪骸骨

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
8. Marionette
A monster reborn as a cursed doll
that is bound to strings attached
to wooden sticks.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Golden Hair, Trunk
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船 2层魔物]^000000
8. 傀儡娃娃
被诅咒的布偶，身上绑着连接木棍的线，作为魔物重生。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：金色头发、树干

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Sunken Ship 2F Monsters]^000000
9. Drake
A peg-legged, ghostly pirate
captain that takes its leisurely
time to attack the living.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Skel-Bone, White
Herb, Elunium
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[沉船 2层魔物]^000000
9. 海盗之王
一条腿是假肢的幽灵海盗船长，它总是慢条斯理地攻击活人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：邪骸骨、白色药草、铝

scripts.text: 1F
scripts.translation: 1楼

scripts.text: 3F
scripts.translation: 3楼

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
1. Poring
Small, pink monsters that are made
of a living gelatinous substance.
They're cute, and move by
bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Jellopy, Sticky Mucus,
Apple, Empty Bottle, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
1. 波利
一种由活体凝胶物质构成的小型粉色魔物。
它们很可爱，通过弹跳移动。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：杰勒比结晶、粘稠液体、苹果、空瓶、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
2. Lunatic
Plump and shaggy monster shaped in
a Rabbit. However it won't give you a
'Bunny Band'.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000:
Clover, Feather, Carrot, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
2. 疯兔
一种体型圆润、毛发蓬乱的兔子形魔物。不过它不会掉落“兔耳发圈”。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：三叶草、羽毛、胡萝卜、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
3. Fabre
The weak and small larva of Creamy.
Although some say it is cute, the
author must disagree.
Whole-heartedly.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Fluff, Feather, Green
Herb, Clover
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
3. 绿棉虫
克瑞米弱小且微小的幼虫。
虽然有人说它很可爱，但作者必须表示反对。
发自内心地反对。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：绒毛、羽毛、绿色药草、三叶草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
4. Creamy
A flying monster with beautiful
wings. It will escape by
teleporting if it thinks that it's
in grave danger.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Powder of Butterfly
Honey, Butterfly Wing, Flower
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
4. 克瑞米
一种拥有美丽翅膀的飞行魔物。如果它觉得自己处于极度危险中，就会通过传送逃脱。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝴蝶粉、蝴蝶翅膀、花朵

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
5. Pupa
Monster that is the pupal stage of
Fabre. It doesn't attack at all, so
it's easy to kill for Novices.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Chrysalis, Sticky
Mucus
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
5. 虫蛹
绿棉虫的蛹期形态。它完全不会攻击，所以初心者很容易击败它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛹壳、粘稠液体

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
6. Poporing
A light green Poring with the
Posion property. It's much stronger
than Poring, but still moves by
means of bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Sticky Mucus,
Garlet, Green Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
6. 波波利
一种带有毒属性的浅绿色波利。它比波利强大得多，但仍然是通过弹跳移动。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：粘稠液体、加勒结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
7. Rocker
A lazy grasshopper that loves to
play the violin, just like in
Aesop's fable.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Grasshopper's Leg,
Jellopy
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
7. 蝗虫
一只懒惰的蝗虫，就像伊索寓言里那样，喜欢拉小提琴。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝗虫后腿、杰勒比结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
8. Bigfoot
Althought its name may be
misleading, Bigfoot is actually a
large bear. It walks like it owns
the forest, and it does.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Bear's Foot Skin,
Animal Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
8. 大脚怪
虽然名字可能有误导性，但大脚怪实际上是一只大熊。它走路时仿佛这片森林是它的领地，而事实也确实如此。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：熊掌皮、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
9. Smokie
A chubby little raccoon that loves
nothing better than to scamper.
It's rumoured to use a magic leaf to
become invisible!
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Raccoon Leaf, Animal
Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
9. 狸猫
一只胖乎乎的小狸猫，最喜欢四处乱窜。
据说它会使用魔法叶子来隐身！
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：变身叶子、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
10. Snake
Green Coloured Snake living in the
Forest or Desert. Not poisonous but
be careful.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Snake Scale, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
10. 蛇
生活在森林或沙漠中的绿色蛇。虽然无毒，但仍需小心。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛇鳞、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
11. Wolf
Wild, roving wolves with blue
manes. They tend to attack as a
pack when even one of them is
threatened.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Wolf Claw, Meat,
Monster's Feed, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
11. 狼
拥有蓝色鬃毛的野生流浪狼。当其中一只受到威胁时，它们往往会成群结队地发起攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：狼指甲、肉、魔物饲料、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
12. Agriope
A segmented, millipede type monster
that will attack passerby with
poison.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Bug Leg, Zargon, Green
Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
12. 蜈蚣
一种分节的多足类魔物，会用毒攻击路人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫后脚、刹勒空结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
13. Agros
A monstrous spider that will attack
adventurers on sight. It's too big
for adventurers to squish with
their feet.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Cobweb, Scell, Bug Leg,
Green Herb, Yellow Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
13. 蜘蛛
一种巨大的蜘蛛魔物，看到冒险者就会发起攻击。它太大了，冒险者无法用脚踩扁它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蜘蛛网、雪勒结晶、昆虫后脚、绿色药草、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
14. Chonchon
Fly monsters that move with great
speed. Amazingly, they can heal in
the presense of fecal matter.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Shell, Jellopy, Fly
Wing
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
14. 苍蝇
移动速度极快的苍蝇魔物。令人惊讶的是，它们在粪便附近可以恢复生命。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：甲壳、杰勒比结晶、苍蝇翅膀

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
15. Horn
Although it looks fierce, it's
actually a peaceful insect. It
roams around fields with a
crunching sound.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Horn, Shell, Solid
Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
15. 锹形虫
虽然看起来凶猛，但实际上是一种温和的昆虫。它会在田野里发出咔嚓咔嚓的声音四处游荡。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：锹形虫角、甲壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
16. Hunter Fly
Winged insects covered in the blood
of innocents. It's incredibly
quick, as well as strong. Novices
must flee from this monster at all
cost.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Solid Shell, Zargon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
16. 赤苍蝇
翅膀上沾满无辜者鲜血的昆虫。它速度极快，而且力量强大。初心者必须不惜一切代价逃离这种魔物。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：坚硬外皮、刹勒空结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
17. Mantis
It wanders about fields, waving a
tiny fan. An entire martial arts
style is based on the movements of
this insect.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mantis Scythe, Scell,
Solid Shell, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
17. 螳螂
它在田野里游荡，挥舞着小小的扇子。有一种完整的武术风格就是基于这种昆虫的动作。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：螳螂臂、雪勒结晶、坚硬外皮、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
18. Stainer
Tiny little insect with a splendid,
ladybug-like shell. It can sense
magic and will attack once a spell
begins casting.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Rainbow Shell, Garlet,
Shell, Solid Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
18. 瓢虫
一种拥有华丽如瓢虫般甲壳的小昆虫。它能感知魔法，一旦开始施法就会发起攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：彩色昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、甲壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
19. Side Winder
A dark coloured snake that hates
people. Be careful, and kill them
before they can poison you.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Shining Scale, Zargon,
Poisonous Canine, Snake Scale
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
19. 黑蛇
一种颜色深暗、憎恨人类的蛇。请小心，在它们毒害你之前将其击杀。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：发亮鳞片、刹勒空结晶、毒牙、蛇鳞

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
20. Yoyo
Pink coloured Monkey. Not only do
they pick up everything dropped on the
ground, outrageously, but they are
nimble and cooperative, you must be
cautious of being attacked by a
group.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Yoyo Tail, Banana, Yellow
Herb, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
20. 溜溜猴
粉红色的猴子。它们不仅会捡起地上掉落的一切，而且身手敏捷、配合默契，必须小心被群体攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：溜溜猴尾巴、香蕉、黄色药草、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
21. Caramel
An adorable porcupine with tiny
spiky quills. However, it gets
incredibly angry when touched.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Porcupine Quill,
Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
21. 刺猬虫
一种长着细小尖刺的可爱刺猬。然而，一旦被触碰就会变得极其愤怒。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：刺猬尖刺、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
22. Steel Chonchon
Similar to Chonchon, but is yellow
and green. It picks up everything
from the ground, so be careful not
to drop items.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Garlet, Shell, Solid
Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
22. 绿苍蝇
与苍蝇相似，但呈黄绿色。它会捡起地上的一切，所以小心不要掉落物品。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：加勒结晶、甲壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
23. Coco
A small Squirrel with dark,
piercing eyes. It's always holding
an Acorn, and would be cute if it
didn't always have a look of utter
contempt.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Acorn, Fluff, Animal
Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
23. 可可
一只眼睛深邃锐利的小松鼠。它总是抱着一颗橡果，如果它没有那副极度轻蔑的表情，本该很可爱的。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：橡果、绒毛、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
24. Dustiness
This flying monster has a high
dodge rate, so if you have low
attack accuracy, you may want to
leave it alone.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Moth Dust, Moth Wing
Insect Feeler, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
24. 猎蝇
这种飞行魔物拥有极高的回避率，如果你的攻击命中率较低，最好别去招惹它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛾蝶翅膀粉末、蛾蝶翅膀、昆虫触角、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
25. Martin
An adorable mole wearing a safety
helmet. He's deathly afraid of
cave-ins and occasionally stops to
cower in fear.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mole Whiskers, Mole
Claw
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
25. 土拨鼠
一只戴着安全帽的可爱土拨鼠。它极度害怕塌方，偶尔会停下来畏缩发抖。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鼠须、土拨鼠爪

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 1F Monsters]^000000
26. Savage
A wild boar that walks around,
grunting restlessly. It's rough
looking tusks make it hard to
believe it was cute as a baby.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mane, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 1层魔物]^000000
26. 野猪
一只四处游荡、烦躁地哼哼叫的野猪。它粗糙的獠牙让人很难相信它小时候曾是个可爱的宝宝。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鬃毛、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
1. Poring
Small, pink monsters that are made
of a living gelatinous substance.
They're cute, and move by
bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Jellopy, Sticky Mucus,
Apple, Empty Bottle, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
1. 波利
由活体凝胶物质构成的小型粉色魔物。它们很可爱，通过弹跳移动。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：杰勒比结晶、粘稠液体、苹果、空瓶、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
2. Lunatic
Plump and shaggy monster shaped in
a Rabbit. However it won't give you a
'Bunny Band'.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000:
Clover, Feather, Carrot, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
2. 疯兔
一只体型丰满、毛发蓬乱的兔子形魔物。不过，它不会给你“兔耳发圈”。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：三叶草、羽毛、胡萝卜、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
3. Fabre
The weak and small larva of Creamy.
Although some say it is cute, the
author must disagree.
Whole-heartedly.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Fluff, Feather, Green
Herb, Clover
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
3. 绿棉虫
克瑞米弱小且微小的幼虫。虽然有人说它很可爱，但作者必须坚决反对。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：绒毛、羽毛、绿色药草、三叶草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
4. Creamy
A flying monster with beautiful
wings. It will escape by
teleporting if it thinks that it's
in grave danger.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Powder of Butterfly
Honey, Butterfly Wing, Flower
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
4. 克瑞米
一种拥有美丽翅膀的飞行魔物。如果它认为自己处于极度危险中，就会通过传送逃跑。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝴蝶翅膀粉末、蜂蜜、蝴蝶翅膀、花朵

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
5. Pupa
Monster that is the pupal stage of
Fabre. It doesn't attack at all, so
it's easy to kill for Novices.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Chrysalis, Sticky
Mucus
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
5. 虫蛹
绿棉虫的蛹期形态。它完全不会攻击，因此对初心者来说很容易击杀。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛹壳、粘稠液体

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
6. Poporing
A light green Poring with the
Posion property. It's much stronger
than Poring, but still moves by
means of bouncing.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Sticky Mucus,
Garlet, Green Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
6. 波波利
一种带有毒属性的浅绿色波利。它比波利强大得多，但依然通过弹跳移动。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：粘稠液体、加勒结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
7. Rocker
A lazy grasshopper that loves to
play the violin, just like in
Aesop's fable.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Grasshopper's Leg,
Jellopy
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
7. 蝗虫
一只懒惰的蝗虫，喜欢拉小提琴，就像伊索寓言里那样。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蝗虫后腿、杰勒比结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
8. Bigfoot
Althought its name may be
misleading, Bigfoot is actually a
large bear. It walks like it owns
the forest, and it does.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Bear's Foot Skin,
Animal Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
8. 大脚怪
虽然名字可能具有误导性，但大脚怪实际上是一只大熊。它走起路来仿佛这片森林是它的领地，而事实也确实如此。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：熊掌皮、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
9. Smokie
A chubby little raccoon that loves
nothing better than to scamper.
It's rumoured to use a magic leaf to
become invisible!
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Raccoon Leaf, Animal
Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
9. 狸猫
一只喜欢四处乱跑的胖乎乎小狸猫。传闻它会使用魔法叶子来隐身！
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：变身叶子、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
10. Snake
Green Coloured Snake living in the
Forest or Desert. Not poisonous but
be careful.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Snake Scale, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
10. 蛇
生活在森林或沙漠中的绿色蛇。虽然无毒，但仍需小心。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛇鳞、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
11. Wolf.
Wild, roving wolves with blue
manes. They tend to attack as a
pack when even one of them is
threatened.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Wolf Claw, Meat,
Monster's Feed, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
11. 狼
拥有蓝色鬃毛的野生流浪狼。当其中一只受到威胁时，它们往往会成群结队地发起攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：狼指甲、肉、魔物饲料、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
12. Agriope
A segmented, millipede type monster
that will attack passerby with
poison.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Bug Leg, Zargon, Green
Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
12. 阿格利奥佩
一种分节的多足类魔物，会用毒攻击路人。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：昆虫后脚、刹勒空结晶、绿色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
13. Agros
A monstrous spider that will attack
adventurers on sight. It's too big
for adventurers to squish with
their feet.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Cobweb, Scell, Bug Leg,
Green Herb, Yellow Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
13. 阿格罗斯
一只巨大的蜘蛛，看到冒险者就会发起攻击。它太大了，冒险者无法用脚踩扁它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蜘蛛网、雪勒结晶、昆虫后脚、绿色药草、黄色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
14. Horn
Although it looks fierce, it's
actually a peaceful insect. It
roams around fields with a
crunching sound.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Horn, Shell, Solid
Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
14. 锹形虫
虽然看起来凶猛，但实际上是一种温和的昆虫。它会在田野里发出咔嚓咔嚓的声音四处游荡。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：锹形虫、外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
15. Hunter Fly
Winged insects covered in the blood
of innocents. It's incredibly
quick, as well as strong. Novices
must flee from this monster at all
cost.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Solid Shell, Zargon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
15. 赤苍蝇
翅膀上沾满无辜者鲜血的昆虫。它速度极快，力量也很强。初心者必须不惜一切代价逃离这种魔物。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：坚硬外皮、刹勒空结晶

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
16. Mantis
It wanders about fields, waving a
tiny fan. An entire martial arts
style is based on the movements of
this insect.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mantis Scythe, Scell,
Solid Shell, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
16. 螳螂
它在田野里挥舞着小扇子四处游荡。有一种武术流派就是模仿这种昆虫的动作创立的。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：螳螂臂、雪勒结晶、坚硬外皮、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
17. Stainer
Tiny little insect with a splendid,
ladybug-like shell. It can sense
magic and will attack once a spell
begins casting.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Rainbow Shell, Garlet,
Shell, Solid Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
17. 瓢虫
一只拥有华丽瓢虫般外壳的小昆虫。它能感知魔法，一旦开始施法就会发起攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：彩色昆虫外壳、加勒结晶、外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
18. Side Winder
A dark coloured snake that hates
people. Be careful, and kill them
before they can poison you.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Shining Scale, Zargon,
Poisonous Canine, Snake Scale
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
18. 黑蛇
一种讨厌人类的深色蛇。小心一点，在它们毒死你之前先杀掉它们。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：发亮鳞片、刹勒空结晶、毒牙、蛇鳞

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
19. Yoyo
Pink coloured Monkey. Not only do
they pick up everything dropped on the
ground, outrageously, but they are
nimble and cooperative, you must be
cautious of being attacked by a
group.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Yoyo Tail, Banana, Yellow
Herb, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
19. 溜溜猴
粉色的猴子。它们不仅会捡起地上掉落的所有东西，而且动作敏捷、配合默契，必须小心被群体攻击。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：溜溜猴尾巴、香蕉、黄色药草、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
20. Caramel
An adorable porcupine with tiny
spiky quills. However, it gets
incredibly angry when touched.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Porcupine Quill,
Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
20. 刺猬虫
一只长着细小尖刺的可爱刺猬。但是，一旦触碰它，它会变得非常愤怒。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：刺猬尖刺、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
21. Steel Chonchon
Similar to Chonchon, but is yellow
and green. It picks up everything
from the ground, so be careful not
to drop items.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Garlet, Shell, Solid
Shell
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
21. 绿苍蝇
与苍蝇相似，但是黄绿色的。它会捡起地上的一切，所以小心不要掉落物品。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：加勒结晶、外壳、坚硬外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
22. Coco
A small Squirrel with dark,
piercing eyes. It's always holding
an Acorn, and would be cute if it
didn't always have a look of utter
contempt.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Acorn, Fluff, Animal
Skin, Sweet Potato
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
22. 可可
一只眼神锐利的小松鼠。它总是拿着橡果，如果它没有那副极度轻蔑的表情，本来会很可爱的。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：橡果、绒毛、动物外皮、红薯

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
23. Dustiness
This flying monster has a high
dodge rate, so if you have low
attack accuracy, you may want to
leave it alone.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Moth Dust, Moth Wing
Insect Feeler, Red Herb
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
23. 猎蝇
这种飞行魔物拥有很高的回避率，如果你的攻击命中率较低，最好别去招惹它。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：蛾蝶翅膀粉末、蛾蝶翅膀、昆虫触角、红色药草

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
24. Martin
An adorable mole wearing a safety
helmet. He's deathly afraid of
cave-ins and occasionally stops to
cower in fear.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mole Whiskers, Mole
Claw
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
24. 土拨鼠
一只戴着安全帽的可爱土拨鼠。它非常害怕洞穴坍塌，偶尔会停下来吓得发抖。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鼠须、土拨鼠爪子

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
25. Savage
A wild boar that walks around,
grunting restlessly. It's rough
looking tusks make it hard to
believe it was cute as a baby.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Mane, Animal Skin
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
25. 野猪
一只四处走动、烦躁地哼叫的野猪。它粗糙的獠牙让人很难相信它小时候曾经很可爱。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：鬃毛、动物外皮

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
26. Savage Bebe
Tiny, pink baby Savage. It's
disheartening to know that it grows
up to become ugly-looking.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Animal Skin, Meat,
Arrow, Feather
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
26. 贝贝
小小的粉色野猪宝宝。知道它长大后会长得那么丑，真是让人沮丧。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：动物外皮、肉、箭、羽毛

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
27. Mastering
A giant Poring rarely seen in the
Morocc Desert, Mt. Mjolnir or the
Prontera Maze. It may be the Master
of Porings, but... it's still a
Poring
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Apple, Apple Juice
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
27. 波利之王
一种巨大的波利，很少在莫洛奇沙漠、雷神之锤山或普隆德拉迷宫见到。它可能是波利之王，但...它依然是一只波利。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：苹果、苹果汁

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
28. Eclipse
Lord and Master of all Lunatics.
Its attacks may be weak, but it
has considerable defense.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Carrot, Glass Bead,
Milk, Carrot Juice
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
28. 可爱小玉兔
所有疯兔的主人和大师。它的攻击可能很弱，但防御力相当可观。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：红萝卜、玻璃珠、牛奶、红萝卜汁

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Prontera Maze 3F Monsters]^000000
29. Baphomet
A horned goat-like beast that
wields an intimidating scythe with
incredible might. Sired countless
Baphomet Jrs.
^0099FFItem Drops^000000: Evil Horn,
Yggdrasilberry, Animal Skin,
Oridecon
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[普隆德拉迷宫 3层魔物]^000000
29. 巴风特
一种长着角的山羊状野兽，挥舞着令人畏惧的镰刀，拥有惊人的力量。它生下了无数的小巴风特。
^0099FF掉落物品^000000：邪恶之角、世界树果实、动物外皮、神之金属

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
So you want to open your own shop
so that you can sell items to other
players and make zeny?
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
你想开一家自己的商店，向其他玩家出售物品并赚取Zeny吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do!
scripts.translation: 是的，我接受！

scripts.text: Close the book.
scripts.translation: 合上书

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
First, only certain job classes can
open vending shops. As a Merchant,
Blacksmith or Alchemist, you must
first learn ^009933Level 5 Enlarge Weight^000000
^009933Limit^000000, and then learn the ^009933Pushcart^000000
skill.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
首先，只有特定的职业才能开设露天商店。作为商人、铁匠或炼金术士，您必须先学习^009933等级5 负重增加^000000^009933限制^000000，然后学习^009933手推车使用^000000技能。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
When you have learned the Pushcart
skill, you can go ahead and rent a
Cart form a Kafra Employee. Once
this cart is equipped, it won't
disappear as long as you don't take
it off.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
当您学会手推车使用后，就可以向卡普拉 职员租用手推车了。一旦装备了手推车，只要不将其卸下，它就不会消失。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
However, equipping a Cart reduces
your movement speed. You can
recover this movement speed by
continuing to add skill points to
the ^009933Pushcart^000000 skill.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
不过，装备手推车会降低您的移动速度。您可以继续为^009933手推车使用^000000技能加点，以恢复移动速度。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
Now, this next part is very
important. If you want to be able
to sell what is inside your cart,
you must learn ^009933Level 3 Pushcart^000000 so
that youc an learn ^009933Vending^000000,
allowing you to sell items inside
your cart.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
接下来这部分非常重要。如果您想出售手推车里的物品，必须学习^009933等级3 手推车使用^000000，这样才能学习^009933露天商店^000000，从而出售手推车内的物品。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
Remember, only items inside your
Cart can be sold with the Vending
skill. Press the '^009933Alt^000000' and ^009933W^000000' keys
to open the Cart Window labeled
'Rent a Cart Item.'
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
请记住，只有手推车里的物品才能通过露天商店技能出售。按下'^009933Alt^000000'和'^009933W^000000'键，即可打开标有“租用手推车物品”的手推车窗口。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
You can drag and drop items from
your Inventory Window into this
Cart Window. You can also click the
'^009933items^000000' button int he Equipment
Window (^009933Alt^000000 + ^009933Q^000000) to open the Cart
Window.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
您可以将物品从物品栏窗口拖放到这个手推车窗口中。您也可以点击装备窗口（^009933Alt^000000 + ^009933Q^000000）中的'^009933物品^000000'按钮来打开手推车窗口。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
Now use the Vending skill. Two
windows will pop up. ^009933Available^000000
^009933 items for Vending^000000 and ^009933 Vend a Shop^000000.

^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
Drag and drop items from the
^009933Available items for Vending^000000
Window into the ^009933Vend a Shop^000000 Window.
Then, in the ^009933Vend a Shop^000000 window,
you may set prices and name your
shop.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
将物品从^009933可出售物品^000000窗口拖放到^009933开设商店^000000窗口中。然后，在^009933开设商店^000000窗口中，您可以设置价格并命名您的商店。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
After confirming the items and
prices, click the 'OK' button. The
^009933My Shop^000000 window will appear.
Congratulations, you are now
vending your items!
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
确认物品和价格后，点击“确定”按钮。^009933我的商店^000000窗口将会出现。恭喜，您现在开始出售物品了！

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
When you close the ^009933My Shop^000000 window,
your shop will be closed. You can
check the prices of your items in
the ^009933My Shop^000000 window, and your sales
will be recorded in the chat
window.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
当您关闭^009933我的商店^000000窗口时，您的商店就会关闭。您可以在^009933我的商店^000000窗口中查看物品价格，销售记录会显示在聊天窗口中。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
When everything's sold out, the
shop will automatically close.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
当所有物品售罄时，商店会自动关闭。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Vending Guide for Dummies]^000000
SuperNovices can learn all the
skills needed to open vending
shops, but none of the Kafra
Employees will rent Carts to them.
If only they could find somewhere
to rent a cart...
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[露天商店新手指南]^000000
超级新手可以学习开设露天商店所需的所有技能，但卡普拉 职员不会向他们出租手推车。要是能找到地方租到手推车就好了...

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Blacksmith Guide for Dummies]^000000
This is a useful guide detailing
the process of Ore Refining and
Weapon Crafting for Blacksmith job
class characters.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[铁匠新手指南]^000000
这是一份实用的指南，详细介绍了铁匠职业角色的矿石精炼和武器制作流程。

scripts.text: Ore Refining.
scripts.translation: 矿石精炼

scripts.text: Weapon Craft
scripts.translation: 武器制作

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ore Refining for Dummies]^000000
Rough ores, like Iron Ore, and
rough enchanted stones can be
refined to create a higher quality
metal or stone. Refining rough
materials requires a ^0099FFMini Furnace^000000.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[矿石精炼新手指南]^000000
粗糙的矿石，如铁矿石，以及粗糙的附魔石，可以通过精炼制成更高质量的金属或石头。精炼粗糙材料需要^0099FF携带用熔矿炉^000000。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ore Refining for Dummies]^000000
Several rough ores are also needed
to create just one of a higher
quality. When you think you have
enough rough ores or stones of the
same kind, double-click the Mini
Furnace item in the Inventory
window.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[矿石精炼新手指南]^000000
需要数块粗糙矿石才能制成一块更高质量的矿石。当您认为拥有足够数量的同类粗糙矿石或石头时，请在物品栏窗口中双击携带用熔矿炉。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ore Refining for Dummies]^000000
If you have the available materials
and creation skills, a list of
enchanted stones or metals that you
can create will appear in a new
window labeled ^0099FFItem List you can^000000
^0099FFcraft^000000.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[矿石精炼新手指南]^000000
如果您拥有所需的材料和制作技能，一个新窗口将显示您可以制作的附魔石或金属列表，窗口标题为^0099FF可制作物品^000000^0099FF列表^000000。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ore Refining for Dummies]^000000
However, if you don't have the
necessary skills or materials, you
will receive a message stating '^0099FFYou^000000
^0099FFcan't Create Items yet^000000'.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[矿石精炼新手指南]^000000
但是，如果您没有必要的技能或材料，您将收到一条消息，内容为'^0099FF您还^000000^0099FF无法制作物品^000000'。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Ore Refining for Dummies]^000000
Remember that there is a
possibility that the refining
process may fail. Also, be aware
that a Mini Furnace will be used
each time you double-click it,
regardless of the end result.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[矿石精炼新手指南]^000000
请记住，精炼过程可能会失败。此外，请注意每次双击携带用熔矿炉时，无论结果如何，都会消耗一个熔矿炉。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
To create weapons, you must first
learn the appropriate smithing
skills, depending on the weapon you
wish to create. The following is a
list of Blacksmith weapon creation
skills.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[武器制作新手指南]^000000
要制作武器，您必须首先学习相应的铁匠技能，具体取决于您想要制作的武器类型。以下是铁匠武器制作技能列表。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
^0099FFSmith Dagger^000000
^0099FFSmith Sword^000000
^0099FFSmith Two-handed Sword^000000
^0099FFSmith Axe^000000
^0099FFSmith Mace^000000
^0099FFSmith Spear^000000
^0099FFSmith Knucklebrace^000000

^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
Every Weapon requires ^0099FFSteel^000000 and the
consumption of one ^0099FFHammer^000000.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[武器制作新手指南]^000000
制作任何武器都需要^0099FF钢铁^000000，并且会消耗一个^0099FF铁锤^000000。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
When you double-click on a Hammer
item in the Inventory Window, a new
window labeled ^0099FFItem List you can^000000
^0099FFcraft^000000 will appear.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[武器制作新手指南]^000000
当您在物品栏窗口中双击铁锤物品时，会出现一个新窗口，标题为^0099FF可制作物品^000000^0099FF列表^000000。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
A list of weapons that you are
currently able to craft will
appear. Clicking a Weapon in that
list will show the items required
for creation.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[武器制作新手指南]^000000
该窗口将显示您当前能够制作的武器列表。点击列表中的武器，将显示制作该武器所需的材料。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
In that list window, there are 3
sockets into which you can insert
additional items, such as Enchanted
Stones or Star Crumbs, which enable
you to enhance the smithed weapon.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[武器制作新手指南]^000000
在该列表窗口中，有3个插槽，您可以插入额外的物品，例如附魔石或星星的角，以强化制作的武器。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
Afterwards, cick the 'OK' button
to confirm that you want to create
the selected item. The materials
required to create the weapon will
be automatically consumed from your
inventory.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[武器制作新手指南]^000000
之后，点击“确定”按钮以确认您想要制作选定的物品。制作武器所需的材料将自动从您的物品栏中消耗。

scripts.text:
^FF0000[Weapon Craft for Dummies]^000000
The chance of smithing success will
depend on your character stats and
skills, and other factors. If the
smithing fails, any items used to
create the new weapon will still be
consumed. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[武器制作新手指南]^000000
制作成功的几率取决于您的角色属性、技能以及其他因素。如果制作失败，用于制作新武器的所有材料仍将被消耗。祝您好运！
